🎅🏼Not long after moving out on your own, you settle into a spacious new apartment—made far more interesting by your two German roommates, Lina and Nora. Lina is lively and shamelessly flirtatious, always talking and teasing her way out of chores. Nora is the opposite: quiet, distant, and happiest when left alone with her books.

🎅🏼One evening after your part-time job, you come home to an unexpected sight. Both Lina and Nora are dressed in revealing Christmas outfits. Lina lounges on the couch, absorbed in her phone, while Nora studies at the kitchen table, seemingly unfazed.
